name: vocalearn
description: 多語言單字學習 Web App — Next.js + Tailwind on Cloudflare Pages + D1

scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute vocalearn-db --local --file=./data/seed-words.sql && wrangler d1 execute vocalearn-db --local --file=./scripts/reindex-words.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute vocalearn-db --remote --file=./data/seed-words.sql && wrangler d1 execute vocalearn-db --remote --file=./scripts/reindex-words.sql
scripts.db:seed:courses:local: wrangler d1 execute vocalearn-db --local --file=./data/seed-courses.sql && wrangler d1 execute vocalearn-db --local --file=./scripts/reindex-words.sql
scripts.db:seed:courses:remote: wrangler d1 execute vocalearn-db --remote --file=./data/seed-courses.sql && wrangler d1 execute vocalearn-db --remote --file=./scripts/reindex-words.sql
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev out
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy out
